name: status-icon
title: Status icon
description: Eight workflow states, each with its own shape so a list, a menu or a dark board reads the same in grayscale: a dashed ring for Backlog, an empty ring for Todo, a quarter for In progress, an arrow coming in for In review, a dashed check for Ready, solid discs for Done and Canceled, and a bar for Blocked. A new state turns in and draws its mark, and Done and Canceled draw their mark in the surface color so it stays crisp in Light and Dark.
